title: Opening Asset Lib causes TLS handshake errors and potential double free crashes
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.4.1 stable
For me, opening the asset library has nearly always caused these errors to be printed.

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

Opening Asset Lib causes the following messages to print to the console:
```
 ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
 ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -1
 ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28928
 ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
 ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
 ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28928
```
I suspect this happens because I am from Australia and the request times out before reaching me because of high ping?

I tested it multiple times, and the error codes and the order that they appear are different
Test 2:
```
 ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28928
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -29056
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28160
```
Test 3, 4: No errors
Test 5:
```
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28928
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -1
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -1
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28928
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28928
```
Test 6: No errors
Test 7:
```
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28928
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -1
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28928
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
```
Test 8: No errors
Test 9:
```
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -28928
  ERROR: modules/mbedtls/stream_peer_mbedtls.cpp:88 - TLS handshake error: -110
```


### Steps to reproduce

1. Open Godot Editor
2. Click on the Asset Lib tab and wait for it to load.
3. Errors pop up!

If the errors don't pop up, try increasing your inbound/outbound ping by using clumsy.
